summary_rationale: Aurobindo Pharma is a vertically integrated global generics, API, and emerging biologics/CDMO platform generating INR 33,653 Cr in FY26 revenue (and a record INR 10,263 Cr in Q2 FY27, +24% YoY) with 20.4%–21.0% EBITDA margins, 113% 10-year CFO-to-PAT conversion, and a INR 3,002 Cr net-cash balance sheet. Europe (>EUR 1B), US complex launches (gAdvair, ADQUEY), Pen-G Kakinada ramp-up (800–900 MT/month), CuraTeQ EMA approvals, and TheraNym's Merck-anchored CDMO provide strong multi-engine growth. However, 5-year sales CAGR of 6.32%, ROCE compression from 27% to 13% (ROE 10.1%) amid INR 24,902 Cr in fixed assets plus CWIP, 326-day inventory bloat, and active USFDA Warning Letters at Eugia Unit III and Unit I prevent an unconditional compounder classification until sterile remediation and asset turns normalize.
